description: Interface describing an auditable item graph vertex.

dateCreated.description: The date/time of when the element was created. json-ld namespace:sch

dateModified.description: The date/time of when the element was modified. json-ld namespace:sch

dateDeleted.description: The date/time of when the element was deleted, as we never actually remove items. json-ld namespace:sch

organizationIdentity.description: The identity of the organization which controls the vertex. json-ld namespace:twin-common

annotationObject.description: The JSON-LD annotation object for the vertex. json-ld namespace:twin-common

aliases.description: Alternative aliases that can be used to identify the vertex. json-ld container:set

resources.description: The resources attached to the vertex. json-ld container:set

edges.description: Edges connected to the vertex. json-ld container:set

verified.description: Is the vertex verified, will only be populated when verification is requested. json-ld namespace:twin-common
